typography.setup: Use @fontsource/outfit for headings and @fontsource/inter for body text.

surfaces.headers: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px border-b border-white/10
surfaces.cards: Flat background (bg-zinc-900 or bg-black), 1px subtle border (border-white/5), hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(37,99,235,0.15)] hover:border-blue-500/30 transition-all

visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid full screen gradients. Use subtle radial glows (e.g., bg-blue-900/20 blur-3xl) behind hero text or active cards.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp with slight rounding (rounded-md). Primary buttons use solid blue (bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500). Secondary use glass (bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10).

sections: Detailed Services (SEO, Web Design, SMM, PPC, Blockchain, AI Development)

grids.services: Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6) with explicit borders.
grids.process: 4-column layout or vertical timeline on mobile.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-20 or py-32 for sections. gap-8 to gap-12 for grids.

image_urls.description: computer circuit board with a brain
image_urls.category: Hero Background or AI Service Card

accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add `data-testid` to all buttons, links, form inputs, and key sections.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has dark overlays (e.g. bg-black/60). Text must pass 4.5:1 ratio.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page React application using react-router-dom for routing between Home, Services, Blog, and Contact pages.
The brand is SL Launchers. Do NOT fabricate facts. Use honest placeholders for stats, testimonials, and past clients, clearly marking them as placeholders.
Services provided MUST include: SEO, Web Design & Development, Social Media Marketing, PPC & Paid Ads, Blockchain Development, AI Development (chatbots, ML, automation).
All navigation must be persistent. Header must have a solid or heavily blurred background.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations on scroll. Elements should not pop in abruptly.
Forms must have proper state management and validation. The contact form should simulate an API submission.
Include floating or prominent WhatsApp and Call buttons on the Contact section.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
